Hi Alice (and Michael),

Thanks for the note — appreciate the heads-up on your timeline. Short answers up front: we can provide an executive/summary PDF immediately; the full penetration test report is available but shared only under a mutual NDA and via our secure evidence-sharing workflow.

What we can do now:
- Attached: PenTest_Summary_2025-09.pdf (executive summary, non-sensitive excerpts)
- If you want the complete report, we will:
  1) send a mutual NDA (DocuSign) for signature,
  2) once executed, provision time-limited access to the full report via our secure share (S3-backed link with audit), and
  3) provide the remediation tracker spreadsheet and any IP ranges used in testing.

Typical timing: 1-2 business days to deliver the summary; 5-10 business days to deliver the full report after NDA execution (depends on legal review and redaction work).

Scope note: Redwood's hosted penetration test covers the Redwood-managed control plane and the hosted inference endpoints (api.redwood-inference.com and CDN fronted endpoints). It does not include customer-managed VPCs or customer data within customer-managed environments. Dev/infra will confirm IP ranges and recent remediation status once I loop them in.

If you want to proceed, I'll send the DocuSign NDA and loop in Dev Patel from our security/infra team to answer technical scope questions.

Hi Alice and Michael — looping in a few details on scope and remediation:  

Scope (short):
- In-scope: Redwood-managed production control plane and hosted inference endpoints (api.redwood-inference.com, auth.redwood-inference.com, edge CDN endpoints we operate).
- Out-of-scope: customer-managed VPCs, customer-managed databases, and any customer-supplied data stores.
- Third-party providers: where a finding traces to a third-party (e.g., managed DB, external CDN provider), the report will call that out; responsibility for remediation either lies with Redwood (for our managed pieces) or with the third party (we note it).

IP ranges used by the pentest engagement (current report):
- 34.203.12.0/24
- 34.203.13.0/24
- 52.23.140.0/24

Remediation status (summary):
- 3 High findings — closed as of 2026-05-02 (patches + config changes applied, validation completed).
- 4 Medium findings — 3 mitigated (workarounds in place), 1 pending remediation (scheduled for 2026-06-10; workaround in place).
- Low findings — documented and monitored; routine hardening applied.

I attached our remediation tracker for the engagement (Remediation_Tracker_Acme_20260523.xlsx). The tracker includes CVE references, remediation owners, and validation evidence links (internal). If you need a version with more redaction removed, let me know.

If OK, Rachel — I'll prepare a short technical exhibit we can include with the NDA that lists the exact hosts and any temporary test IPs. Happy to hop on a 20-minute call with Michael next week to walk through the tracker.
